name: Conspiracy
overview: The Bible clearly condemns conspiracy as unrighteous and deceitful, warning against raising false reports or joining with the wicked to pervert justice, as seen in Exodus 23:1-2. The narrative examples show conspiracies arising from envy and rebellion, such as Joseph’s brothers plotting to kill him (Genesis 37:18) and Korah’s rebellion against Moses’ leadership (Numbers 16:1). These accounts reveal how conspiracies often stem from selfish ambition and opposition to God’s appointed authorities, resulting in division and judgment.
